pattern.description: The large gradient orb shrinks to centre, then a row of five white pill tracks grows outward with small gradient-orb knobs inside; the tracks lengthen while each knob glides to a different height, ending as a mixer-style rack of voice controls.
pattern.why_premium: The hero orb becomes the knobs of the control UI, so the brand shape carries meaning (tone, emotion levels) instead of a cut to a generic UI; tracks and knobs move on separate, offset timings, and the uneven knob heights read as tuned settings.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: orb to {scale: 0.55, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in'}; then tracks fromTo {height: knobSize, opacity: 0} -> {height: full, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: {each: 0.04, from: 'center'}}; knobs fromTo {scale: 0.4, y: 0} -> {scale: 1, y: target_i, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.inOut', stagger: {each: 0.04, from: 'center'}}; slowly rotate each knob's gradient.
build_hint.remotion: Per column i: s = spring({frame: frame - 18 - Math.abs(i-2)*1, fps, config: {damping: 22, stiffness: 120}}); trackHeight = interpolate(s, [0,1], [knobSize, fullHeight]); knobY = interpolate(s, [0,1], [0, target_i]); knobScale = interpolate(s, [0,1], [0.4, 1]); orb pre-shrink via interpolate(frame, [0, 15], [1, 0.55], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad)}).

notes: Energy drops to ~0 mid-burst (orb gone, tracks not yet drawn), so the orb-to-sliders handoff may be a near-instant swap rather than a true morph. b02 groups three middle knobs because no per-knob candidate exists; b01 (union) is used for the track row.
